description: This file defines a service layer class `TicketService` that manages operations related to tickets, including creation, classification, retrieval, listing, priority management, and model training, by interacting with repositories, machine learning models, and configuration objects.

classes.name: TicketService
classes.description: Provides coordinated operations on tickets, including creation, classification, listing, priority management, and retraining ML models.

methods.name: Dict submit_ticket(self, title: str, description: str)
methods.description: Creates a new ticket and classifies it immediately, returning the enriched ticket data.

methods.name: Optional[Dict] classify_ticket(self, ticket_id: str)
methods.description: Classifies an existing ticket by ID and updates it with the predicted label and probability.

methods.name: Optional[Dict] get_ticket(self, ticket_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a ticket by its ID.

methods.name: List[Dict] list_tickets(self)
methods.description: Lists all tickets, serialized into dictionaries.

methods.name: Dict[str,int] get_priorities(self)
methods.description: Returns the current mapping of labels to priority levels.

methods.name: Dict[str,int] update_priority(self, label: str, priority: int)
methods.description: Updates the priority level for a given label.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] train_model(self, samples: List[TrainingSample])
methods.description: Retrains the ML model with augmented data and reclassifies existing tickets.

methods.name: Optional[Dict] _serialize_ticket(self, ticket: Optional[Ticket])
methods.description: Converts a Ticket object into a dictionary format suitable for serialization.

methods.name: None __init__(self, repo: TicketRepository, model: TicketPriorityModel, priority_cfg: PriorityConfig)
